LAND ACQUISITION ACT 1960

LAND ACQUISITION (VALUATION FEE) RULES 2022

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 14(5) and paragraph 69 (d)
of the Land Acquisition Act 1960 [ Act 486 ], the Minister, with the approval
of the National Land Council, makes the following rules:

Citation and commencement
1. (1) These rules may be cited as the Land Acquisition (Valuation Fee)
Rules 2022.

 (2) These Rules come into operation on 1 October 2022.

Valuation fee
2. The valuation fee for an award made under subsection 14(1) of the Act
shall be as prescribed in the Schedule.

SCHEDULE

[Rule 2]

VALUATION FEE

A. The valuation fee for an award between RM1.00 to RM1,000,000.00
